cards.text: The Nile has already been turned to blood (Exodus 7:20). Then the LORD tells Moses, Israel's leader, to go to Pharaoh, king of Egypt, with this message: 'Let My people go, so that they may worship Me.' Short line, BIG king. Friend, I'd be delivering that one from behind my mustache.

cards.question: If Pharaoh refuses to let the LORD's people go, the LORD says He will plague Pharaoh's whole country with ___.

cards.text: And these frogs won't stay politely in the river. The LORD says the Nile will teem with them, and they'll come into Pharaoh's palace, up to his bedroom and onto his bed.

cards.question: The frogs are headed for Pharaoh's bed and into the houses of his officials and his people. Where else does the LORD say the frogs will go?

answers.text: Into their ovens and kneading bowls
Into their grain storehouses and barns
Into their wells and water jars

cards.text: And the LORD says the frogs will come up on Pharaoh, his people and all his officials. Friend, I've opened a LOT of oven doors, and not once did the batch look back at me.
Then the LORD tells Moses to pass a message to Aaron, Moses' brother: stretch out your staff over the rivers, canals and ponds, and bring the frogs up onto the land of Egypt.
So Aaron stretches out his hand over the waters of Egypt, and the frogs come up and cover the land. Then Pharaoh's magicians step up with magic arts of their own.

cards.question: Pharaoh's magicians try to copy the frogs with their magic arts, but they can't do it.
With frogs everywhere, Pharaoh summons Moses and Aaron. What does Pharaoh ask them to do?

answers.text: Pray to the LORD to take the frogs away
Strike the river with the staff again
Order the frogs out of the palace

cards.question: Pharaoh says that if the frogs are taken away, he'll let the people go to sacrifice to the LORD.

cards.text: Moses tells Pharaoh, 'You may have the honor over me.' Then he lets Pharaoh choose when Moses should pray for the frogs to be taken away.

cards.question: Pharaoh gets to pick when Moses will pray for the frogs to be taken away. What does Pharaoh pick?

cards.text: Frogs all over Egypt, and Pharaoh picks TOMORROW?! Moses goes right along with it: 'May it be as you say,' he replies.

cards.question: Moses agrees to tomorrow. What does Moses say it will show Pharaoh?

answers.text: There is no one like the LORD our God
Moses is a servant of the LORD our God
The land of Egypt belongs to the LORD

cards.question: Moses says every last frog will leave Egypt, even the frogs in the Nile.

cards.text: Moses and Aaron leave Pharaoh, and Moses cries out to the LORD for help with the frogs. And the LORD does as Moses requested.

cards.question: The LORD does as Moses asked. What happens to the frogs in the houses, the courtyards and the fields?

answers.text: They hop back into the Nile

cards.text: The dead frogs get piled into countless heaps, and there's a terrible stench in the land. Friend, that's coming home from a week away to the trash you forgot to take out, except the smell is coming from EVERYWHERE.

cards.question: But when Pharaoh sees there's relief from the frogs, he ___ his heart.
Pharaoh won't listen to Moses and Aaron, just as the LORD had said.

cards.text: Then the LORD gives Moses another message for Aaron. Stretch out the staff and strike something.

cards.question: What is Aaron told to strike with his staff this time?
Aaron is to strike the dust of the earth so it turns into swarms of ___ throughout the land of Egypt.

cards.text: Aaron strikes the dust, and all the dust of the earth turns into gnats throughout Egypt, on man and beast. Friend, I spent years in a junk drawer counting dust as it fell, and not ONE speck ever got up and flew.

cards.question: The magicians copied the frogs with their magic arts. Now they go for the gnats. How does it go?

answers.text: They make only a few gnats

cards.question: The gnats stay on man and beast, and the magicians can't copy them. What do the magicians tell Pharaoh?

answers.text: This is the finger of God
This is the staff of Aaron
This is the hand of Moses

cards.question: After the magicians speak up, Pharaoh finally listens to them.

cards.text: Pharaoh's heart is hardened again, just as the LORD had said. We'll pull this batch out of the oven here, friend, but this story is still baking.
